name: 415 · IDoc Guard · REAL SAP · Multi-Item ORDERS05

parameters.content:
## Multi-item order with real master data

The Code node creates one complete `ORDERS05` with customer `0017100001`, sales area `1710/10/00`, order type `OR1`, requested delivery date and materials `TG11`/`TG12`. Unit `PCE` is the ISO value expected by the inbound processor.

The WE20 partner profile processes the IDoc immediately. A successful run creates a sales order and ends in application status 53; transport confirmation alone is not that application result.
